analyst.summary: KSB Limited makes industrial pumps and valves, including specialized equipment for nuclear power plants, and is the Indian arm of a German engineering group. The standard scoring data for this stock was almost entirely missing, but our own research found a profitable company with a healthy, diversified order book spanning power, nuclear, petrochemical, metro and water projects. We rate it a Hold based on what we could verify, while flagging that the underlying data coverage for this stock needs to be fixed.
